$description: Julienna Batten brand tokens (v1, 2026). W3C design-tokens style. Source of truth: src/styles/global.css in the portfolio repo. Dark set is documented, not shipped.

surface.$description: Bands: proof rail, footer base, tab bars.

surface-2.$description: Inset wells, segmented tracks, bento cells.

line.$description: Hairlines, dividers, idle edges, node strokes.

ink.$description: Headings and body text. 17.9:1 on white.

muted.$description: Secondary text. 6.8:1 on white, passes AA.

primary.$description: Button fills, key emphasis. White text on it: 6.8:1.

primary-hover.$description: Hover fill. White text on it: 7.8:1.

graphic.$description: Non-text graphic teal: port fills, done edges. 2.4:1 vs white, never text.

graphic-deep.$description: Active edges, focus rings, progress. 3.8:1 vs white, non-text only.

graphic-tint.$description: Teal wash behind strokes and swatches.

danger.$description: Form errors only: error borders and error message text. 6.55:1 on white, AA. State semantics, never decoration.

dash-ink.$description: Placeholder labels. 5.5:1 on white, 4.8:1 on surface-2.

on-ink-muted.$description: Secondary text on ink bands. 9.0:1 on ink.

dark.$description: Documented for a future dark mode. Nothing ships these yet.

primary.$description: Lifted teal. Pair with dark ink-text (7.1:1); white text is not used on it.

ink-text.$description: Text color on dark primary fills.

mono.$description: Only for node titles, port labels, file names, data excerpts, stat labels, placeholder labels.

typeScale.$description: Sizes are CSS clamp() strings; lh = line-height, ls = letter-spacing, wt = weight.

radius.$description: Nested elements step down one radius.

inset.$description: Inputs, swatches, segmented controls, nested media.

card.$description: Cards, nodes, app windows, bento cells.

shadow.$description: Cool-tinted shadow color oklch(0.3 0.03 220 / a). Border OR shadow, never both when blur exceeds 8px.

packet.$description: Packet travel is linear. No overshoot, spring, or bounce anywhere.
